Thursday Morning Cruise

El Paso, TX · West Side / Canutillo · Road

No-drop

Thursday Morning Cruise is a road group ride in El Paso, TX. It rolls every Thursday at 7:00 am from Starbucks at the Outlet Shoppes. About 25–30 miles, 14–16 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @elpasobicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursday Morning Cruise group ride

A no-drop weekday ride on the upper valley roads. About 25 to 30 miles at 14 to 16 mph. Non-members are welcome. Departure time moves with daylight, so check Meetup, and arrive 15 minutes early to sign in.
